verdict.rationale: Slack documents an official, first-party Slack MCP server that MCP clients and AI assistants can connect to. Its tools cover searching Slack, reading and sending messages, drafting messages, canvases, users, file uploads, and lists, and workspace admins can approve and manage the MCP client integrations. A probe confirms the dedicated MCP server docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a working agent connection, and concrete connection/auth setup details in the evidence.
